title: Packwand extension manifest
description: Declares a first-party Packwand extension. Extensions live in apps/packwandrs/extensions/<id>/, are written in TypeScript, and are bundled into the app at build time. Third-party extensions are not supported.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Stable identifier. Must match the extension's directory name; used to namespace its command ids.

name.description: Human-readable name. Used as the default palette group heading.

version.description: Extension version, tracking the Packwand release it ships with.

apiVersion.description: Version of the typed Packwand extension SDK used by this package.

description.description: One line on what the extension contributes.

entry.description: TypeScript entry point relative to the extension directory. Must default-export definePackwandExtension(...).

activation.description: Events which make the extension applicable. '*' activates in every project.

capabilities.description: Maximum privileged operations the host may expose to this extension.
